lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar karahi je aapanee taa(n) aape laihi savaar ||
lines.translation: But if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then He Himself embellishes us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh jinhee dhiaaiaa aae se paravaan ||63||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord; blessed and approved is their coming into the world. ||63||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਗਵੀ ਕਪੜੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog na bhagavee kapaRee jog na maile ves ||
lines.translation: Yoga is not obtained by wearing saffron robes; Yoga is not obtained by wearing dirty robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ghar baithiaa jog paaeeai satigur kai upades ||64||
lines.translation: O Nanak, Yoga is obtained even while sitting in your own home, by following the Teachings of the True Guru. ||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa je bhavahi bed paRahi jug chaar ||
lines.translation: You may wander in all four directions, and read the Vedas throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa bhetai har man vasai paavahi mokh duaar ||65||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if you meet with the True Guru, the Lord shall come to dwell within your mind, and you shall find the door of salvation. ||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਮਤਿ ਭਵੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam varatai khasam kaa mat bhavee phirahi chal chit ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master, is prevailing. The intellectually confused person wanders around lost, misled by his fickle consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸੁਖ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਮਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sau kar dosatee sukh k puchhahi mit ||
lines.translation: If you make friends with the self-willed manmukhs, O friend, who can you ask for peace?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਉ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sau kar dosatee satigur sau laai chit ||
lines.translation: Make friends with the Gurmukhs, and focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੀ ਮਿਤ ॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran kaa mool kateeai taa(n) sukh hovee mit ||66||
lines.translation: The root of birth and death will be cut away, and then, you shall find peace, O friend. ||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਸੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhuliaa(n) aap samajhaaisee jaa kau nadar kare ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself instructs those who are misguided, when He casts His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree baaharee karan palaah kare ||67||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are not blessed by His Glance of Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||67||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaageeaa sohaaganee jinhaa guramukh miliaa har raai ||
lines.translation: Blessed and very fortunate are those happy soul-brides who, as Gurmukh, meet their Sovereign Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jot paragaaseeaa naanak naam samaai ||1||
lines.translation: The Light of God shines within them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur purakh hai jin sach jaataa soi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has realized the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit miliai tikh utarai tan man seetal hoi ||
lines.translation: Meeting Him, thirst is quenched, and the body and mind are cooled and soothed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur sat purakh hai jis no samat sabh koi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the True Primal Being, who looks upon all alike.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur niravair hai jis ni(n)daa usatat tul hoi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who has no hatred; slander and praise are all the same to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur sujaan hai jis a(n)tar braham veechaar ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the All-knowing True Guru, who has realized God within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satigur nira(n)kaar hai jis a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the Formless True Guru, who has no end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satiguroo hai j sach driRaae soi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who implants the Truth within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur vaahu vaahu jis te naam paraapat hoi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, Blessed and Great is the True Guru, through whom the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh sachaa sohilaa guramukh naam govi(n)d ||
lines.translation: For the Gurmukh, the true Song of Praise is to chant the Name of the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam salaahanaa har japiaa man aana(n)d ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Praises of the Lord, their minds are in ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee har paaiaa pooran paramaana(n)d ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, they find the Lord, the Embodiment of perfect, supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahiaa bahuR na man tan bha(n)g ||3||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no obstacle will block his mind or body. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂੰ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: moo(n) pireeaa sau nehu kiu sajan milahi piaariaa ||
lines.translation: I am in love with my Beloved; how can I meet my Dear Friend?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau dhoodhedee tin sajan sach savaariaa ||
lines.translation: I seek that friend, who is embellished with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur maidaa mit hai je milai ta ihu man vaariaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is my Friend; if I meet Him, I will offer this mind as a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਮੂੰ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: de(n)daa moo(n) pir das har sajan sirajanahaariaa ||
lines.translation: He has shown me my Beloved Lord, my Friend, the Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਭਾਲੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hau pir bhaalee aapanaa satigur naal dikhaaliaa ||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I was searching for my Beloved; the True Guru has shown me that He has been with me all the time. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਖੜੀ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੰਧੁ ਮਤੁ ਮੂੰ ਸਜਣੁ ਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau khaRee nihaalee pa(n)dh mat moo(n) sajan aavae ||
lines.translation: I stand by the side of the road, waiting for You; O my Friend, I hope that You will come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਅਜੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ko aan milaavai aj mai pir mel milaavae ||
lines.translation: If only someone would come today and unite me in Union with my Beloved.
